links.comparator_used: Conventional fixed diagnostic reference level (DRL) exceedances applied to all patients
links.outcome: Number of cases flagged for dose review (alert burden)
links.effect: 60 statistical outliers from patient-specific models vs 170 DRL exceedances; manual analysis confirmed all flagged cases were clinically justified
links.quote: Crucially, the patient-specific models identified substantially fewer cases for review (60 statistical outliers) compared with the standard DRL-based method (170 exceedances).

design_hint: patient-specific alert thresholds for dose monitoring
